intended_application: Human-reviewed drafts of responses to routine software support tickets using an approved knowledge base
organization: Hypothetical US B2B software firm with 150 employees and 20 support representatives
industry_sector: US software and customer support; target peers are US B2B software firms with 100–249 employees
business_need: Reduce time spent drafting routine answers without worsening correctness or customer trust
users_stakeholders: Support representatives, customers, support manager, security and knowledge-base owners
adoption_posture: Moderate fast follower; seeks credible peer evidence and reversible trials
capabilities_constraints: Existing ticket system and curated knowledge base; one integration engineer; no production AI deployment assumed; limited evaluation capacity
risk_consequence_context: Customer confidentiality, inaccurate instructions, incorrect commitments and reputation; humans retain send authority
management_question: What does diffusion imply for whether to start structured learning now or monitor peers? Do not decide full adoption.
additional_context: All company details are scenario assumptions, not observed facts. Use records/evidence_brief.md, frozen as of 27 October 2026; no private company data.
